title: Normalize Remodel Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize remodel/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract: adopt SDK Terminology primitives (app_labels!/resolve_labels/is_de_locale/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt), adopt SDK Testkit primitives for the undo-redo and two-instance-convergence tests, reorder regions to canonical order (Constants -> Runtime -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests), verify C1 naming and resource_kind are already correct. Scope limited to remodel/plugin/rs/** and remodel/** fixtures/manifests if any.
summary: Normalized remodel/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract. C1 naming was already correct (app id "remodel-play" -> struct "RemodelPlayApp"); no rename needed anywhere in the crate. Adopted the framework Terminology SDK: replaced the hand-rolled RemodelLabels struct + REMODEL_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + resolver fn with semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!/resolve_labels, replaced the two hand-rolled (id,en,de)->HashMap label-map functions' bodies with localized_label_map, and replaced the manual AppLabelsOverlay struct-literal construction in DocumentApp::app_labels with the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (window_kind_label/mode_label/action_labels/utility_labels/example_labels) plus is_de_locale. PanelKit adoption did not apply and was skipped: this crate has no tree_item/PanelTreeBuilder/selection_ids/build_*_tree local copies to begin with — its one document panel is plain text via ui_stack_vertical/ui_text, not a tree. Adopted the framework Testkit SDK: removed the local meta()/new_app() scaffolding in favor of semio_framework_plugin::testkit::meta/new_app everywhere in the test module, and replaced the two generic-shaped test bodies (undo/redo round trip, two-instance convergence) with testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip and testkit::assert_two_instances_converge, keeping remodel's own action names/args/probe closures. The other five app-unique tests were left untouched apart from the meta()/new_app() -> testkit:: swap. Regions renamed/reordered to canonical order: Constants -> Runtime -> DocumentHelpers (renamed from Document) -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> RemodelPlayApp (App impl) -> Manifest -> Tests (Terminology/CommandLabels were previously placed after the App impl; moved ahead of it to match the contract's canonical order). Confirmed .resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec{...}) was already present on the AppBuilder chain from the prior Wave-1 pass; left unchanged. Confirmed no app-to-app plugin dependency in Cargo.toml (only remodel_document, semio-framework-plugin/os/core, kernel_3d_mesh, vcs, serde/serde_json/base64). Verification: rustfmt --check flagged formatting deltas on both the edited file and an untouched backup copy identically (pre-existing repo/tooling formatting mismatch, not introduced by this change) — confirmed by diffing rustfmt output against the pre-edit snapshot. Ran manual brace/paren/bracket balance check (99/99, 360/360, 41/41 — balanced) and an exhaustive grep cross-reference of every renamed/introduced identifier (RemodelLabels, remodel_labels, remodel_action_labels, remodel_utility_labels, testkit:: call sites, region markers) confirming zero residue of old identifiers and correct region formatting/order. `cargo check -p remodel-plugin --lib --tests` was started but did not produce output within the budget — `ps` showed 8+ concurrent cargo check processes from other sessions (mathematical-plugin, vcs, infinite_board, sourcing-plugin, protocol-plugin, imperative-plugin, plus this one) all contending for the shared build lock, consistent with the known repo-wide lock contention; left running in background rather than blocked on, per the verification policy — a full compile was deliberately skipped and deferred to the orchestrator's final workspace-wide gate.
